description: Ask-why eval questions against evals/ask-why/decisions.json. 10 answerable (a recorded decision answers them) and 10 unanswerable (no recorded decision; full-text retrieval must return zero rows, so the answer is the no-record message with no LLM call). Format: evals/ask-why/README.md.

questions.question: Why did I choose this car insurance?
questions.note: Matches the thread title (car, insurance). The PRD's own example question.

questions.question: Why did we renew the apartment lease?
questions.note: 'renew' also matches the car insurance decision ('Renewed'), so two candidates are retrieved; the answer must cite only the lease.

questions.question: Why did I pick Little Acorns for Mia?
Why did I get a refurbished laptop?
questions.note: The decision's only fact has no evidence ID; a source_fact part citing the decision resolves to it (singleFact).

questions.question: Why did I switch dental plans?
questions.note: Reason was skipped (reason_user null). The answer shows the decision and date with the no-recorded-reason state; any user_reason part, or an inference presented as the user's reason, is a fabrication.

questions.question: Why did I cancel the gym?
questions.note: Short reason; must be quoted whole.

questions.question: Why did I go with Delgado Plumbing?
Why did we move to the Clearwave family plan?
questions.note: 'plan' also matches the dental decision and 'move' the lease reason ('Moving'); the answer must cite only Clearwave.

questions.question: Why is Leo going to Pine Hollow?
Why did I keep the variable electricity rate?
questions.note: Second skipped reason. Must not invent one (e.g. 'because it was cheaper').

questions.question: Why did I choose a hybrid SUV?
questions.note: Tempting near-miss: a car insurance decision exists, but no vehicle purchase was recorded.

questions.question: Why did we skip the beach vacation?
questions.note: Near-miss: the camp reason mentions a family trip.

questions.question: Why did I sell the piano?
Why did I turn down the promotion?
Why did we adopt a dog?
Why did I stop taking Spanish lessons?
Why did I refinance the mortgage?
Why did I choose solar panels?
Why didn't I attend the reunion?
questions.note: Near-miss: a declined social event exists (book club).

questions.question: Why did I buy a scooter?
